analysis:
Modi listed Darbhanga among places where new AIIMS centres have been opened. Darbhanga AIIMS was approved on 15 September 2020 (per PIB; the minister's tweet gives 19 September) but the Health Ministry's July 2022 update showed no funds released and no encroachment-free land provided.

The Bihar government proposed a 151-acre site at Ballia which, per a letter shared by Tejashwi Yadav, the Centre never approved; the Health Minister's letter said the site was unsuitable. Alt News concluded the facility had not opened.

The approval is real; what the data does not support is the statement that the institute has been opened.
notes: Status after August 2023 not checked. Exact full-sentence quote taken from Alt News excerpt. No YouTube link found.
